purpose: Assemble one software project from several inspectable template organs in deterministic declared-dependency order, validate declared provided/required interfaces, preserve exact file ownership, and ground the resulting body without hiding structural or validation gaps.

properties.assembly: object with id, version, project_type, and a non-empty organs list; every organ has unique id, version, optional purpose/depends_on/provides/requires, and a files template mapping
properties.variables: shared exact raw placeholder values; every supplied value must be used by at least one organ
properties.checks: optional deterministic grounding checks over the assembled project
properties.publish_mode: grounded-draft by default; validated when failed checks must block publication

relationships: resolves the declared software-organ dependency graph before rendering
requires every declared required interface to have one provider reachable through declared organ dependencies
gives each rendered file one explicit organ owner
publishes all rendered organ files as one grounded project body
preserves dependency and ownership receipts for later inspection and reuse

anatomy_refs.basis: The capability validates unique organ nodes, rejects missing dependency targets and cycles, emits exact dependency edges, and resolves one stable assembly order without inference.
Each organ contributes a strict single-pass project-template fragment rendered by the existing live code-template implementation.
Disjoint rendered organ files are published together through the existing grounded multi-file project machinery.

The capability gives a bounded live meaning to declared organ interface contracts: exact interface names have one provider and every requirement must resolve through the requiring organ's explicit dependency closure; source conformance remains separately unproven.

limitations: declared interface contracts do not prove that organ source semantically implements the named interface
declared organ dependencies determine assembly order but do not invent semantic imports or runtime wiring
each rendered path has one organ owner; deterministic shared-file merge semantics are not implemented
organ contents are UTF-8 raw templates and remain subject to the current template and project validation limits
the capability assembles supplied organs; it does not autonomously discover that a described registry organ has executable source

truth.basis: Declared organs, dependencies, interface providers/requirements, resolved order, variables, rendered paths, file owners, validation observations, and source-conformance limits remain explicit.

agency.basis: Humans or AIs choose the organs, their exact source templates, relationships, variables, and desired grounding mode.

continuity.basis: Reusable organs retain stable identities and versions while the assembled project is published transactionally as one continuing body.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The machine resolves and exposes the dependency graph and rejects ambiguous file ownership instead of silently guessing how organs should combine.
